story.title: Turkey? No thanks. HEB ISD students dish out Thanksgiving favorites, family traditions
story.summary: At Meadow Creek Elementary’s Generations Day, students shared favorite foods, treasured traditions and gratitude for loved ones. Max McGee has a Thanksgiving menu that would make Charlie Brown proud. Toast. Jelly beans. Pretzel sticks. Popcorn. The Meadow Creek Elementary second grader’s reasoning? “Because it’s fun and it tastes good,” Max said. Max was one of hundreds of Hurst-Euless-Bedford ISD students who welcomed parents, grandparents and other loved ones for Meadow Creek’s annual Generations Day on Nov. 20. Held just before Thanksgiving break, the event brought families together to share lunch and spend time with those who make the holiday special. His real-life plate might also feature mashed potatoes, chicken — not turkey — and fries. Just don’t add peanut butter. Sitting around cafeteria tables beside parents and grandparents, with a smorgasbord of Bedford’s finest fast-food…
